newsitem.title: UK: HAZLEWOOD SELLS POTATO OPS FOR 45 MLN STG.
newsitem.headline: HAZLEWOOD SELLS POTATO OPS FOR 45 MLN STG.

text.p: UK food processing and fresh meats groups Hazlewood Foods said on Tuesday it had entered into an agreement to dispose of its Dutch and Czech potato processing operations for around 45 million stg.
It is selling the operations to Danisco Holding BV, a wholly owned unit of Danisco A/S .
The company said in a statement that the proceeds from the disposal of the Fri d'Or operations in the Netherlands and the Czech Republic will be used to reduce debt.
"This disposal is a further significant step forward in Hazlewood's strategy of focusing on the attractive and growing convenience food markets," the company said.
It also reported an 8.8 percent jump in pre-tax profits before exceptional items of 37.0 million stg for the year to March 31, up from 34.0 million the year before.
It proposed a total dividend of 6.9 pence per share, up three percent.
"We are very encouraged that the volume and margin momentum of the second half of 1996/97 has been maintained in the start to the current year," said chairman Peter Barr.
"I look forward to reporting on another year of pre-exceptional profits growth i n 1997/98".
